thread:
acme_infra: Hey team — running the private collector on our staging host to gather a debug bundle; the upload keeps failing with a 403 from S3. Request ID provided by collector: X-Req-ID=acme-req-0a9f. Can we get help?
Sam (Support): sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the collector version and the exact command you used to run the collector? also any short log snippet showing the 403 would help.
acme_infra: collector v1.4.2
acme_infra: command: `/opt/redwood/collector collect --output /tmp/debug-acme.tar.gz --include-logs --redact basic`
acme_infra: log snippet: ```2026-03-02T15:01:12Z ERROR uploader.go:132 upload failed status=403 url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-private-uploads/... err=AccessDenied X-Amz-Request-Id=3X9ABC123```
Sam (Support): thanks. two quick asks: 1) can you run `date -u` on the host and paste the output, 2) can you try a direct curl to the presigned PUT URL so we can see the body of the 403?
acme_infra: date -u -> `Tue Mar 02 15:00:58 UTC 2026`
acme_infra: tried curl PUT: ```curl -v -T /tmp/debug-acme.tar.gz "https://presigned.example.s3.amazonaws.com/put/abcd?X-Amz-Signature=..." -H "Content-Type: application/gzip"``` response: ```< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< x-amz-request-id: 3X9ABC123
< x-amz-error-code: AccessDenied
< x-amz-error-message: Access Denied```
Priya (Platform Eng): two likely causes: 1) presigned URL expired / clock skew, 2) egress to s3 endpoints blocked by customer firewall / VPC egress rule. Since `date -u` looks ok, let's test simple reachability: `curl -I https://s3.amazonaws.com` and `curl -I https://presigned.example.s3.amazonaws.com`
acme_infra: `curl -I https://s3.amazonaws.com` returns: ```HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden``` (company firewall returns 403 for that host)
Luis (SRE): that indicates outbound egress is being intercepted. For Private deployments customers sometimes have a proxy that rewrites requests or blocks AWS hostnames. Two options: a) allow direct egress to the Redwood upload host/presigned domain, b) use collector's `--upload-endpoint` to point to an internal proxy that will forward to presigned URL.
Sam (Support): meanwhile, if you want us to ingest the bundle directly we can provide a short-lived presigned PUT to your bucket or you can scp the file to our secure intake host. If you prefer presigned from our side, we can generate a POST form for you. Which do you prefer?
acme_infra: we'd rather not open additional egress rules right now. Please give us instructions for a manual scp -> you can provide a temporary account?
Priya (Platform Eng): we don't create customer accounts. Easiest: we'll generate a short-lived presigned PUT URL that you can curl to. But your firewall may still block that domain. Another approach: share the bundle over your side's sftp to `support@redwood-sftp.redwood.ai` — I'll open a ticket with infra to create a one-time user and dropbox path.
Sam (Support): before upload, please run the collector again with full-redaction and include the explicit flag so we don't accidentally receive PHI. Command: ```/opt/redwood/collector collect --output /tmp/debug-acme-redacted.tar.gz --include-logs --redact full``` After that run: `sha256sum /tmp/debug-acme-redacted.tar.gz` and paste the checksum here.
acme_infra: ran it. checksum: `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41...`
acme_infra: ready to upload but firewall still blocks direct PUT to S3; send the sftp path.
Luis (SRE): created sftp drop at `sftp://support-drop.redwood.ai/acme/1769003456/` — credentials and ephemeral key sent to your email. Upload instructions: `sftp -i /path/to/key support@support-drop.redwood.ai:/acme/1769003456/` then `put /tmp/debug-acme-redacted.tar.gz`
acme_infra: upload complete. server responded: `Transferred: /tmp/debug-acme-redacted.tar.gz 100%  14.8MB  15.3MB/s 00:00`
uploader-bot: new debug bundle ingested: name=debug-acme-redacted-1769003456.tar.gz size=15432109 sha256=e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41... redaction=full received_by=support-drop redwood-request-id=rb-5541
Sam (Support): confirmed ingestion, X-Req-ID mapping to your earlier upload attempt: acme-req-0a9f -> rb-5541. We'll run the initial analysis and follow up with a redaction-safe excerpts pack within 24 hours.
acme_infra: thanks all! appreciate the quick workaround — please confirm if we need to whitelist any hostnames for future automated uploads.
Priya (Platform Eng): whitelist recommendations (minimum): `presigned.example.s3.amazonaws.com` (your presigned domain), our upload host `support-drop.redwood.ai`, and allow HTTPS egress to `s3.amazonaws.com`/`s3.<region>.amazonaws.com` if you want full collector automation. Also allow outbound time sync (NTP) to avoid signature issues.
Sam (Support): marking this thread resolved for now. I'll attach follow-up steps in the support ticket including the redaction checklist and curl reproducible commands: ```# reproduce upload failure (from host) curl -v -T /tmp/debug-acme-redacted.tar.gz "<your-presigned-put-url>" -H "Content-Type: application/gzip" # collect debug (redacted) /opt/redwood/collector collect --output /tmp/debug-acme-redacted.tar.gz --include-logs --redact full ```
acme_infra: got it, thanks :thumbsup:
